title: Free producer build dir before verifier; resume retry after env stop
summary: Goal: stop environment-caused failures (jobs 20261028-055601-hg0n and 20261028-065911-m6m5, low disk before the verifier) from costing a full re-plan and rebuild. After Athena's checks pass, remove target/produce before the verifier starts. When a job stops for an environment cause after its candidate is built, `athena retry` resumes at the stopped stage from the kept candidate, as timed-out producer work is resumed today.

defaults_applied.how: Tests for both behaviors; fmt, clippy -D warnings and cargo test pass.
Behavior criteria name cargo commands the verifier can run.
Fixes both the disk use and the lost work on retry, not one instance.
Tests check the directory is gone and no planner or producer runs, not that wiring exists.
One focused change in run/mod.rs plus changelog.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job 20261028-055601-hg0n: its finding (low disk 9.8 GB of 10 GB before the verifier) is fixed by removing the producer build dir after passing checks, and its re-plan cost by the resume path. Job 20261028-065911-m6m5: same finding (9.5 GB), addressed the same way; both were stopped at the environment gate, not for the work.
Audience: the Athena operator who runs `athena retry` and judges cost and time.
The existing timed-out kept-work mechanism (keep_timed_out_work, kept_work_dir, remove_kept_work in run/mod.rs) is extended rather than replaced.
The existing 10 GB low-disk gate before the verifier stays; no automatic cleanup beyond target/produce.
Checks that fail keep target/produce for the send-back.
reading.rs changes only if retry resolution of the prior job's reading or stage needs it.
No change to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test in crates/athena-core shows target/produce of the job is absent after checks pass and before the verifier runs, and present when checks fail (for the send-back). Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.

A test stops a job on low disk before the verifier, then runs athena retry and shows only the verifier runs on the kept candidate, with zero planner and zero producer invocations. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing both fixes (build dir removal before verifier; resume after environment stop), citing jobs 20261028-055601-hg0n and 20261028-065911-m6m5.

git diff shows the retry resume applies to environment causes (low disk, usage limit, interrupted process) after the candidate is built, and the timed-out producer resume still works; existing tests for it still pass.
athena.toml, defaults.toml and .github/workflows do not appear in git diff.

out_of_scope: Automatic disk cleanup beyond removing target/produce, or disk reservation
Changing the 10 GB minimum free-disk threshold
departures: Higher cost and time than reference: the change touches run pipeline and retry logic in a very large file, and needs two new integration-style tests.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time and cost from failed attempts whose retry re-plans and rebuilds from scratch ($4.92).
hard_reason: Changes the run pipeline and how retry resumes a stopped job, so a mistake is costly and hard to see.
